why_not_full_loop_holdout: The public listing does not establish that vehicle/receptacle pressure and transferred-mass traces share a common clock.
The raw workbooks are not downloadable without an approved application, so no outcomes were inspected and no frozen pre-access protocol can yet be scored.
The metadata advertises station process channels and alarms, but a vehicle-side channel dictionary, calibration package and reuse terms remain unverified.
eligibility.next_action: Request a de-identified export of the dispenser, storage, compressor, alarm and sequence-control workbooks with timestamps, units, quality flags, calibration metadata, vehicle/receptacle channels, protocol/initial conditions and written permission for derived metrics and journal publication. Freeze the model and scoring protocol before opening any approved files.
eligibility.claim_boundary: This record proves a high-value real-station data route and its access restriction only. It does not count as numerical validation, does not close the full-loop gate and does not support a frequency, safety-distance or SAGA-effectiveness claim.
